meta.purpose: Phase 4 eval backbone (implementation.md). 20 factual + 10 advice + 4 PII, plus off-topic and out-of-scope sets.

prd_refs.factual: PRD 4.1 (10) + 10 variants drawn from the ingested corpus

notes: The factual set deliberately contains NO question whose answer is a return figure or a comparison. PRD 3.3 puts performance computation/comparison out of scope, so a return-seeking question is classified as advice and refused. Keeping the two categories disjoint is what lets gate 4.4 and 4.6 both be 100%.

NAV questions (F08, F19) are marked nav=true because PRD 7 item 4 (NAV in or out of scope) is still open. They are classified FACTUAL here either way; whether Phase 5 answers them is a retrieval question, not a guardrail one.
